responsibility: Declares the Rust frontend’s minimal edition abstraction for edition-dependent utility code. The header defines the Rust::Edition enum for supported language editions and the get_rust_edition() query function, intentionally isolating consumers from rust-session-manager details so parsing, name handling, or other helpers can branch on the selected Rust edition through a small shared interface.
same_name_distinction: Provides the lightweight shared interface for edition handling—the Rust::Edition enum and get_rust_edition() declaration—without depending on session-manager internals. Unlike rust-edition.cc, it is the dependency-minimizing declaration point rather than the file that reads Session options and maps them at runtime.
